name: session.focus_window
description: Make a window the active window. Focus goes to the block it last had focused.

window_id.description: The window to make active. Focus goes to the block that was focused in it.

revision.description: The session's revision after this call. It is unchanged if the call changed nothing that session.view shows, unless the method's notes say otherwise.

validation_notes: If the window is already active, the call changes nothing.
If the session doesn't exist, the call fails with `session_not_found`. If `window_id` names a window that isn't in the session, it fails with `not_found`.
